_meta.title: Upload a video to a YouTube channel
_meta.description: Upload a local video file to a YouTube channel in Studio: attach the file by its path, set title and description, answer not made for kids, disclose AI use, add it to a playlist, choose the visibility, publish, and read back the youtu.be link.

auth.note: Mike's Chrome must be signed in to the Google account that owns the channel. SOMA Studios (UCxJydLvsDTvWH41YXC4UdnA) and AI WTF (UC40elGacNV5R5z4OLJvPSOw) are Brand Accounts under mw@mike-wolf.com, so their Studio URLs open without switching identity.

file.description: Absolute path of the video on the Mac, e.g. /Users/mikewolf/Projects/abundance-film/out/youtube/abundance-lead-cut3.mp4. Any size: attach_file hands Chrome the path.

description.description: Video description. Newlines are kept. For SOMA work end it with `provenance line <artifact-id>`.

visibility.description: PUBLIC, UNLISTED or PRIVATE (the radio button's name attribute). Mike, 2026-11-12: public unless there is a good reason not to.

playlist.description: Exact name of an existing playlist on the channel, e.g. Abundance. Create a new playlist in Studio first.

_meta.doneWhen: s19 sees YouTube's 'Video published' share dialog with a youtu.be link, and s20 stores that link as published_url. A run without published_url did not publish. After the run, confirm processing with https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg returning 200 (oEmbed proves nothing).
_meta.risk: PUBLISHES — s18 clicks Publish (or Save for UNLISTED/PRIVATE). To fill the dialog without publishing, stop after s16; the upload stays as a private draft. Never reload or navigate the run's tab while a file is uploading: the upload lives in that tab (kinetic-lyric-video skill, 2026-10-29: page loads killed 8 of 12 uploads). An unverified channel stops at about 10 uploads a day.

selectorNotes.file_input: ytcp-uploads-file-picker input[type=file][name=Filedata] — one light-DOM input, multiple=true, checked live 2026-11-12. attach_file sets it through CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles; Chrome fires change and the dialog moves to Details.
selectorNotes.title_description: Both are contenteditable #textbox elements. Their aria-labels start 'Add a title' and 'Tell viewers' (2026-11-12). The `type` action selects the contents and inserts the text with CDP Input.insertText.
selectorNotes.made_for_kids: tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name=VIDEO_MADE_FOR_KIDS_NOT_MFK]. A new channel leaves this unset, and Next stays disabled until it is answered.
selectorNotes.ai_use: The 'Yes, AI was used' radio ignored a scripted .click() on 2026-11-12 and took a real click, so s10 uses a trusted click_text.
selectorNotes.category: Not set by this recipe. On SOMA Studios it defaulted to Music on 2026-11-12; set Film & Animation (films) or Music (songs) in Studio afterwards if it matters.
selectorNotes.visibility: Step badge #step-badge-3 opens the Visibility step; radios carry name PUBLIC, UNLISTED, PRIVATE. #done-button reads Publish for PUBLIC and Save otherwise.
selectorNotes.playlist: A playlist ticked in an earlier upload's dialog stays ticked on the next one. s12 clicks the named playlist's row, so check the read-back in s13b when the previous upload used a different playlist.

history: 2026-11-12: written from the hand run that uploaded the four Abundance films and the making-of to SOMA Studios through chrome-devtools (https://youtu.be/8l3vJrwjx8g and three more). Built on the new attach_file action. Not yet replayed live: the next real film upload is its first run. Claude Opus 5.5 for Mike Wolf (EM thread 'Link every artifact to its conversation').

chain.note: Studio renders the dialog lazily; a hidden tab may not draw it.
The Details step appears once YouTube accepts the file.
YouTube prefills the file name; type replaces it.
Show advanced settings: paid promotion and AI use live there.

chain.text: No, my video doesn’t include paid promotion
chain.note: Already the default on 2026-11-12; kept so a changed default does not slip through.
YouTube's policy: realistic AI pictures and an AI voice must be disclosed. SOMA films always use AI.
Ticks the playlist in the Choose playlists dialog.
Should read the playlist name, or 'N playlists' if an old tick carried over.
The video's link exists as soon as the upload starts.
PUBLISH (Save for unlisted/private). YouTube publishes when the upload finishes, as long as this tab stays open and is not reloaded.
PROOF: the 'Video published' dialog with the link.
